title: Request Header and Origin Bypass Techniques
detail:
X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1 / X-Real-IP / X-Client-IP (bypass IP allowlists/internal-network restrictions)
Host header: password reset poisoning, cache poisoning, routing confusion
Referer: bypass hotlink/origin checks
Method bypass: GET→POST/PUT/PATCH; ?_method=DELETE (framework method override)
Path bypass: /admin/./ , //admin, /admin%20, /admin/.;, ;/admin (path parameter/semicolon matrix); case changes /Admin
Parameter pollution: HPP takes the latter parameter in some stacks
Content-Type switching: json↔form to bypass parsing differences in WAFs
Auth headers: X-Original-URL / X-Rewrite-URL (.NET behavior) to bypass front-end routing
Authentication bypass: JWT none (see the JWT entry); session fixation; oauth redirect_uri not validated
